ledger.x: c. 600: Tiwanaku rises as the regional power of the southern Titicaca basin. Infobox 'c. 600-c. 1000'; 'large parts of the city were rebuilt around 600' and the population grew rapidly from about 600 to 800; other settlements had been abandoned between 450 and 550. The Tiwanaku page: site 'founded around AD 110'.

c. 1000: Tiwanaku collapses. 'Appeared to have collapsed around AD 1000' (Tiwanaku page); ceramic production stopped about 1000 and the Moquegua colony and the urban core were abandoned within a few decades; a severe drought is the proposed cause, which later chronologies dispute.
